mission.title: Sympathy From a Friend
mission.description: Find out where Morpheus is from one of his friends.

npc.say: Morpheus will free The One and save us all!
Morpheus? Hahaha! Oh, you can't help him. Not now.

phase.briefing: Greetings, Warrior. We have a very important mission for you today. The Council fears that Morpheus' recent sabotage of the Matrix will endanger the Truce with the Machines. For the greater good of our cause, you must find Morpheus and dissuade him from this rash course of action. We've located one of our operatives who may know of Morpheus' current whereabouts. Please attempt to get some useful information from this person. Morpheus must be found, and quickly!

enter.say: I know that it seems like an unlikely location, but you will find Malik Lu in that building: a Zion operative and one of Morpheus' friends. Be careful not to offend him or he won't help you. If he becomes hostile, leave immediately--we must not brew dissent among our own people.

talk.say: You wanna know about Morpheus? Well lissen up and I'll let you in on a little secret. Morpheus knows the truth! The truth, you know? The Machines have Neo and they're torturing him in horrible ways! Tentacles and needles and stuff, get it? Morpheus wants The One freed!

done.say: This man's wits have left him. What could have done this to one of our operatives? You'd better leave him in peace.

mission.finish: {player}, pay no heed to the ravings of lunatics. Morpheus is out there, and we can, and will, find him and bring him back to Zion!
